function: Predicts the optimal mmWave beam index (64-beam codebook) from UE GPS and BS camera and LiDAR data, in a V2I link framed as ISAC (pp. 1, 8).
system: BS with N-element ULA, camera and LiDAR; one mobile UE with mmWave transmitter and GPS; no RIS; mmWave band, exact frequency not stated (pp. 3, 8).
method: Supervised hybrid quantum-classical networks: amplitude-embedding PQC with one entangling layer, 1-D CNN, transformer or ViT-S/16, MLP fusion; focal loss, 50 epochs, quantum layer simulated (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: Measured DeepSense 6G V2I scenarios 31-34 (7012, 3235, 3981, 4439 samples) with GPS, camera, LiDAR and mmWave power; train and test split from scenarios 32-34 (pp. 8-9).
test_conditions: Trained on scenarios 32-34 (80/10/10 split); tested on held-out data and zero-shot on scenario 31, excluded from training, without adaptation (pp. 8-9).
baselines: Learned only: Position-Aided-NN [19], PointNet LiDAR [40], ResNet-34 [51], Transformer-CNN+YOLOv8, PointNet+Position-Aided-NN, TII TransFuser [23], classical counterparts of own hybrid models; no non-learned method (pp. 10-11).
metrics: Distance-based accuracy (DBA, K=3), top-1/2/3 beam accuracy, mmWave power loss P_L,k in dB, parameter count and big-O complexity (pp. 10-13).
complexity: Parameter counts (QFusionNet-GPS 1.03 M; ViT-S/16-Fusion Quantum 25.86 M plus 3.20 M YOLOv8) and big-O per layer in Table V; no runtime (pp. 10, 12-13).
openness: none (no code release; public DeepSense 6G data set [17] used, no link given)
q1_support: p. 8: "We leverage the DeepSense 6G data set for empirical analysis, which comprises a rich set of measurements"; p. 1: "collected through real-world measurements by deploying testbeds".
q2_support: p. 9: "We consider Scenario 31 as zero-shot testing, where the model is evaluated in a new environment different from the training scenarios (excluded in training)".
q3_support: p. 11: "In contrast, the Position-Aided-NN model exhibits a substantially lower top-1 accuracy of 22.62%"; Table V (p. 10) lists only neural baselines. Missing: no non-learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 12: "we consider the number of parameters and big-O notation as model complexity"; p. 13: "The parameters of QFusionNet-GPS are 1.03 M".
q5_support: p. 8: "we use the DeepSense 6G data set to evaluate the performance of the proposed models"; public measured V2I data set, no own code link.
notes: Included as area 5 because the paper frames sensing-aided mmWave beam prediction as ISAC (title, abstract, p. 1); the beam serves communication and sensor data are inputs, so area 3 is the alternative. q3 is 0 because every baseline is learned. Quantum layer is simulated (p. 9).
